scope: retrospective frozen P6/P8/P4 inference on every available authorized PTB-XL v1.0.3 fold 1-9 waveform, not independent validation

reference.positive: exact SCP code with likelihood greater than zero and no NORM code
reference.control: positive-likelihood NORM with no other statement except optional SR
reference.ambiguous: target code with zero likelihood or with NORM
reference.NSR: not evaluated: SR indicates sinus rhythm, not necessarily normal sinus rhythm; all SR likelihood values are unknown in folds 1-9
reference.ISC_: non-specific ischemic ECG statement, not an independently adjudicated diagnosis

score_policy: unchanged released thresholds and P8 fallback, no fitted thresholds, no abstention or referral
